title: AUDIT_ASSIGNMENT_V1
description: JSON schema for Observe.ai bulk S3 export of audit assignment records. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON (AUDIT_ASSIGNMENT_V1_<timestamp>.json.gz). Each record is one JSON object.

_id.description: Unique identifier for this record (source system primary key).

assignment_configuration_id.description: Identifier of the parent assignment configuration.

start_time.description: UTC timestamp when the record/session started.

end_time.description: UTC timestamp when the record/session ended.

auditorId.description: Auditor identifier assigned to the interaction.

auditId.description: Identifier of the audit evaluation once completed.

evaluatorId.description: Original evaluator identifier for the interaction.

evaluationId.description: Original evaluation identifier for the interaction.

items.description: One interaction included in the audit assignment.

agent_meeting_count_filters.description: Filter criteria used to select agent interaction counts for the assignment.
agent_meeting_count_filters.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

evaluator_meeting_count_filters.description: Filter criteria used to select evaluator interaction counts for the assignment.
evaluator_meeting_count_filters.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

created_by_user_id.description: Identifier of the user who created the assignment.

assignment_progress.description: Overall completion progress of the assignment (0-1 or %).

progress.description: Percentage of assigned meetings audited by this auditor (0-100).

auditor_progress.description: Per-auditor completion progress for this assignment.

matchScore.description: Percentage match between audit and original evaluation (0-100).

items.description: Match score between an audit and its original evaluation.

audit_match_score.description: Match score(s) between auditor and original evaluator.

items.description: Per-question match score between an audit and its original evaluation.

evaluation_template_id.description: Identifier of the evaluation template used for this assignment.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

modified_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was last modified.
